title: Foundry Platform Manifest
description: Declarative manifest for a Foundry-managed platform. Defines WHAT the platform is — its topology, services, databases, and CI/CD configuration.

$schema.description: URI for the JSON Schema used to validate this manifest.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the Foundry manifest specification.

repository.description: Name of the root repository folder for this platform (used by Foundry CLI).

foundry.description: Foundry CLI metadata — minimum version requirements and tool-level config.

template.description: Records which template generated this manifest. Informational — not enforced after init.

prefix.description: Short prefix derived from the platform name (e.g., 'Acme Cloud Platform' → 'aap'). Used for AWS resource naming, secret prefixes, and satellite repo discovery ('{prefix}-*'). Auto-derived from name if not set.

structure.description: Enforced directory layout for the platform. Foundry requires a canonical structure: apps/{backend,frontend}, ci/{db,scripts,iac}, packages/. This block allows overriding the top-level directory names if needed, but the internal shape is fixed.

github.description: GitHub organization and cross-repo configuration. v0.4.0 replacement for the 'ecosystem' block.

ecosystem.description: [DEPRECATED in v0.4.0 — use 'github' instead] Cross-repository ecosystem topology.

databases.description: [DEPRECATED in v0.4.0 — declare inline per-service instead] Top-level database schemas. In v0.4.0, prefer declaring 'database' as an inline object within each service.

services.description: Service declarations for this platform. Keys are service directory names within apps/backend/, apps/frontend/, or packages/. Defines WHAT exists — runtime/launch configuration lives in .foundry/runtime.yml.

ci.description: Continuous Integration and infrastructure orchestration configuration.

iac.description: Tool used for infrastructure as code. OpenTofu is the recommended default — same HCL syntax and provider ecosystem as Terraform, but genuinely open source under MPL 2.0.

iacDir.description: Relative path to the IaC directory (default: 'ci/iac').

provider.description: Primary infrastructure provider for this platform.

pipeline.description: Relative path to the CI/CD pipeline definition (e.g., '.github/workflows/ci-cd-pipeline.yml').

environments.description: Maps deployment environments to the Git branch that triggers them. Foundry CLI defaults: prod→release, dev→develop, test→qa.

foundryConfig.description: Foundry CLI metadata. Allows manifests to declare minimum CLI version requirements.

minCliVersion.description: Minimum Foundry CLI version required to work with this manifest.

templateConfig.description: Records which template was used to generate this platform. Informational — the CLI does not enforce template constraints after init.

version.description: Version of the template that was used.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the platform was generated.

githubConfig.description: GitHub organization and cross-repo configuration. Replaces 'ecosystemConfig' in v0.4.0 — focused on GitHub-specific concerns (org, repos).

organization.description: GitHub organization that owns all platform repositories.

repositories.description: Map of related repositories in the ecosystem. Keys are logical names, values describe the repo and its relationship.

structureConfig.description: Directory layout overrides. Foundry enforces a canonical structure (apps/backend, apps/frontend, ci/db, ci/scripts, ci/iac, packages/) but allows the top-level directory names to be customized.

appsDir.description: Directory containing backend/ and frontend/ service directories (default: 'apps').

ciDir.description: Directory containing db/, scripts/, and iac/ (default: 'ci').

ecosystemConfig.description: Describes the broader platform ecosystem — the GitHub organization, related repositories, shared libraries, and cross-cutting concerns. Only the primary platform repo has a foundry.json — satellite repos are referenced here.

organization.description: GitHub organization that owns all platform repositories. Required — this is the anchor for cross-repo discovery and artifact registry scoping.

prefix.description: Short prefix derived from the first letter of each word in the platform name (e.g., 'Acme Cloud Platform' → 'aap'). Used to discover satellite repos matching '{prefix}-*'. Auto-derived if not set; must be at least 2 characters.

repositories.description: Map of related repositories in the ecosystem. Keys are logical names, values describe the repo and its relationship.

apiLib.description: The API library repository — the contract-first source of truth for API specs, generated code, and shared models.

repositoryReference.description: A reference to a related repository within the platform ecosystem.

relationship.description: How this repo relates to the current repo.

apiLibConfig.description: Configuration for the platform's API library repository.

packageRegistry.description: Where the api-lib packages are published.

groupId.description: Maven groupId or npm scope for published packages.

modules.description: Map of logical module names to their artifact coordinates.

apiLibModuleConfig.description: A single module within the api-lib repository.

version.description: Current published version of this module.

specPath.description: Relative path (within the module) to the OpenAPI spec file.

databaseConfig.description: Configuration for a database schema managed by this platform.

changelog.description: Relative path to the Liquibase master changelog file.

properties.description: Relative path to the Liquibase connection properties file.

secretId.description: AWS Secrets Manager secret ID containing database credentials (JSON with engine, host, port, dbname, username, password).

environmentConfig.description: Configuration for a deployment environment. Maps a Git branch to a named environment.

branch.description: Git branch name that triggers deployment to this environment.

enabled.description: Whether this environment is active. Disabled environments are excluded from pipeline triggers and deployment. Default: true.

autoApprove.description: Whether deployments to this environment require manual approval. Default: false (require approval).

iac.description: Infrastructure-specific configuration for this environment. Contains provider-specific details (AWS region, account, domain, global resources like lambdas and bastion). Supports {name_prefix}, {prefix}, {env} template variables resolved at generation time.

deployConfig.description: Deployment configuration. In v0.5.0, this is a mandatory block for deployable services (strategy is required). The convention engine derives defaults for other fields from stack + scope.

strategy.description: How this service is deployed. 'service' = containerized (ECS Fargate), 'static' = S3/CDN static hosting, 'none' = not deployed (packages).

dockerfile.description: Path to Dockerfile relative to repo root. Convention: apps/{kind}/{name}/Dockerfile.

buildContext.description: Docker build context relative to repo root. Convention: '.' for monorepo (Spring Boot), service dir for standalone (Python).

buildCommand.description: Build command for non-Docker builds (static sites). Convention: derived from type (e.g., 'pnpm build' for nextjs/vite).

secrets.description: Secrets to fetch from Secrets Manager before build/deploy. Convention: derived from type (microlith-spring-properties for Spring Boot, {name}-env for others).

cdn.description: CDN (CloudFront) configuration. true = auto (read distribution ID from IaC outputs), false = none, object = custom config. Convention: true for s3-static, true for nextjs ECS, false for backend.

dependsOn.description: Services or phases that must complete before this service deploys. Convention: all services depend on 'iac'; services with databases depend on 'database:{db-name}'; services with sidecars get 'sidecar:{name}' dependencies.

sidecars.description: Sidecar containers deployed alongside this service in ECS. Convention: derived from role (e.g., auth → OpenFGA sidecar).

iac.description: Infrastructure-specific deployment configuration for this service. Contains provider-specific details (compute, ALB, security groups, IAM policies, database, sidecars). Passed through to the tfvars generator. Supports {name_prefix}, {iac_name}, {manifest_name}, {prefix}, {env} template variables.

secretMapping.description: Maps a secret from Secrets Manager to a file in the build context. Supports interpolation: {prefix}, {env}, {service}.

source.description: Secrets Manager secret name. Supports interpolation: {prefix}-{env}/microlith-spring-properties.

target.description: Where to write the secret value. Relative path from repo root. Supports interpolation: apps/backend/{service}/src/main/resources/application-{env}.yml.

format.description: How to process the secret value before writing. 'raw' = write as-is, 'dotenv' = parse as dotenv, 'extract-key' = extract a specific key from JSON.

extractKey.description: When format is 'extract-key', the JSON key to extract from the secret value.

cdnConfig.description: CDN configuration for static or frontend deployments. When specified as an object, allows customizing CDN behavior beyond the auto-detected defaults.

distributionIdOutput.description: JSON path within iac-outputs.json to find the CloudFront distribution ID. Convention: derived from service name and IaC output structure.

invalidationPaths.description: Paths to invalidate in CloudFront after deployment. Default: ['/*'].

sidecarDeployConfig.description: Configuration for a sidecar container deployed alongside a service in ECS.

cpu.description: CPU units for the sidecar container. Default: 128.

memory.description: Memory (MiB) for the sidecar container. Default: 256.

command.description: Command override for the sidecar container.

environment.description: Environment variables for the sidecar container.

serviceConfig.description: Declaration of a single service or package in the platform. v0.5.0 groups concerns into structured blocks: scope (visibility), stack (technology), deploy (shipping), run (local dev).

scope.description: Visibility scope of the service: 'public' (internet-facing) or 'internal' (private/platform-only).

stack.description: Technology stack of the service — what it's built with.

deploy.description: How the service is deployed. Mandatory for deployable services. Packages (stack.type='package') don't need this.

run.description: How the service behaves with 'foundry run'. Defines ports, arguments, health checks, and environment variables for local development.

database.description: Database this service uses. An inline config object (engine, changelog, properties) or a string referencing a key in the top-level 'databases' map (deprecated).

kind.description: [DEPRECATED in v0.5.0 — use stack.type instead] The stack category.

type.description: [DEPRECATED in v0.5.0 — use stack.framework instead] The runtime/framework.

role.description: [DEPRECATED in v0.5.0 — use scope instead] Semantic role of the service.

strategy.description: [DEPRECATED in v0.5.0 — use deploy.strategy instead] How this service is deployed.

stackConfig.description: Describes the technology stack of a service — what category it falls into, what framework it uses, and what language it's written in.

type.description: The stack category. Must match the physical directory: 'backend' → apps/backend/<name>/, 'frontend' → apps/frontend/<name>/, 'package' → packages/<name>/.

framework.description: The runtime/framework that determines how the service is built and started.

language.description: Primary programming language of the service.

runConfig.description: Local development runtime configuration — how the service behaves with 'foundry run'. Defines ports, arguments, health checks, and environment overrides.

actuatorPort.description: Actuator/health-check port for local development (Spring Boot).

args.description: Startup arguments for local development (e.g., ['-Dspring-boot.run.profiles=local']). Args starting with -D are passed as Maven system properties; others as application arguments.

healthCheck.description: Health check endpoint path for local development (e.g., '/actuator/health').
